brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
CICC's 2027 Hong Kong Stock Market Outlook states the Hong Kong market can only move forward by breaking through existing barriers. [1]
BIT Capital is expanding its Asia-Pacific activities with a focus on Hong Kong and Singapore, bringing its Human × AI approach to Asian investors. [3]

KEY RISKS
The most severe government travel advisory for Hong Kong is Exercise Increased Caution, which may deter business travel and investment. [E1]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the trademark dispute between NewJeans agency Ador and a Hong Kong fashion retailer will be resolved. [2]
